description: bbs-foundations doctrine: before a subscribed skill runs — whether Claude calls the Skill tool (PreToolUse) or the user types the slash command (UserPromptExpansion) — inject the BBS CLAUDE.md doctrine or the grounding doctrine as context. Subscriptions and text live in hooks/doctrine/; the scripts re-key nothing. Interpreter chosen by the shell Claude Code runs hooks through (Git Bash on Windows, sh on macOS): pwsh 7, else Windows PowerShell 5.1, else python3 (doctrine.py, same logic), else nothing. Fails open: never blocks a skill.

hooks.command: command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.py"; exit 0

command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.py"; exit 0
